english.title: Contravene a Health and Safety improvement or prohibition notice

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Health and Safety at work etc Act 1974

(B)_[prohibition]_

english.legislation: Contrary to section 33(1)(g) of, and Schedule 3A to, the Health and Safety at Work etc Act 1974.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)

Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Section 38 of the Health and Safety at Work etc Act 1974 provides restrictions on the institution of proceedings in England and Wales. Proceedings for an offence under any of the relevant statutory provisions shall not, in England and Wales, be instituted except by an inspector or the Environment Agency or by or with the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions.

consent.description: Health and Safety at Work Inspectorate

other.penalty:
Summary: Twelve months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Until the commencement of section 154(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 the reference to 12 months should be read as a reference to 6 months.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
